set.body: Pin independently authored AOI/fixation inputs with exact integer/rational oracle outputs, including saccade/blink gaps, background/off-surface interruptions, overlapping membership, initial entries and sample-versus-fixation estimands. Register per-ticket fixture/generator and portable conformance. State precisely what eyesim does or does not expose at the pin; owner convention and independently verified native accounting must not be overstated as measured reference parity. Verify fixture regeneration and preserved outputs; combine CR7 slices in one landing gate.
set.title: CR7 S4: independent fixation AOI accounting fixture and qualified parity note
